name: Bent Pyramid
scope: Surviving main Bent Pyramid exterior only; satellite pyramid, temples, causeway, enclosure and interior excluded.

references.caption: Cropped from File:Panoramica Dahshur.jpg to use as an article banner at Wikivoyage

review.method: Full local published Qualla public-domain Pentaur panorama inspected.
review.notes: Native panorama shows the large main pyramid at right: steep casing below distinct bend, shallower upper slopes and rough dark crown. Detached Black Pyramid at left and desert surroundings excluded. Stones/hidden faces remain approximate.
